integrity: The complete general proof is analytic; finite geometric-union computations are supplementary. Known convexification threshold results are expressly credited and not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement is for planar unit-circumradius odd regular polygons, dilation >=1; a central-area defect is not claimed for general polygons, smaller dilation, or higher dimensions.
title: Exact disappearing central-hole law for regular-polygon vertex sums
